observations.behavior: Adds dashboard visibility filtering to dashboard listing and permission assertions; also removes the LIST action from dashboard permission checks and its associated expected results.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks whether a dashboard is visible to a subject before asserting dashboard permissions, rather than relying on the OpenFGA result alone. This could help prevent permission assertions on dashboards that are not visible to the subject, potentially improving the accuracy of permission checks and reducing unnecessary OpenFGA calls.
